newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian rupee slips back as RBI buys dollars.
newsitem.headline: Indian rupee slips back as RBI buys dollars.

text.p: * Reserve Bank of India (RBI) buys dollars in early afternoon trade to check the rupee's rise against the U.S. currency, dealers said.
* Rupee weakens below 35.70 on RBI dollar purchases after touching a new seven-month high of 35.69 earlier in the afternoon.
* Dollar quoted 35.715/725 rupees in latest deals.
* Rupee hit a seven-month high of 35.735 on Thursday, moving up from opening quotes of 35.755/765 on poor demand and RBI inaction.
* Dealers said trade on Friday remains light and demand for dollars subdued.
